description: Returns a collection of expenses. Requires the Kimai Expenses plugin. HAND-AUTHORED: this endpoint is absent from the open-source /api/doc the catalog was generated from, so its parameters were reconstructed from Kimai's shared collection-filter conventions and from live calls made by kimai_list_expenses in v0.2.0. Treat the parameter list as observed rather than specified, and expect a 404 on any instance without the plugin.

200.description: Returns a collection of expense entities

404.description: Expenses plugin is not installed on this instance

description: Returns absences (holiday, sickness, time off) for a user over a date range. Requires the Kimai Work Contract plugin. Useful for explaining gaps in a timesheet report before assuming time went unlogged. This endpoint is NOT paginated: it returns the full range in one response, so a wide begin/end can return a large payload. HAND-AUTHORED: see get_expenses for what that means about parameter fidelity.

params.name: user
params.description: User ID to fetch absences for. Defaults to the API token owner.

params.name: begin
params.description: Range start as an HTML5 local date-time, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00.

params.name: end
params.description: Range end as an HTML5 local date-time.

200.description: Returns a collection of absence entities

404.description: Work Contract plugin is not installed on this instance
